svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Data center migration to AWS
svg.desc: Data center migration to AWS. 11 components in 7 groups. Connections: VMware servers to AWS Direct Connect (replicate); PostgreSQL to AWS Direct Connect (replicate); File share to AWS Direct Connect (copy); AWS Direct Connect to AWS Transform MGN (block replication); AWS Direct Connect to AWS Database Migration Service (change data capture); AWS Direct Connect to AWS DataSync (file transfer); AWS Transform MGN to Amazon EC2 (launch); AWS Database Migration Service to Amazon Aurora (load); AWS DataSync to Files bucket (write); AWS Transform to Staging subnet.

text.tspan: Servers, a PostgreSQL database and a file share move over one AWS Direct Connect link, each with its own migration service
